issues.headline: Lumina OLED firmware freeze — critical new defect
issues.detail: This issue emerged suddenly in May with 4 cases and represents a previously unseen product failure mode. Immediate investigation and customer communication are needed to determine scope and whether a firmware rollback or patch is required.

issues.headline: AeroSnap X200 battery drain — stabilizing after KB article
issues.detail: Cases peaked at 8 in May but dropped to 0 in June following publication of a knowledge article, indicating the self-service content is effectively resolving customer issues. Continued monitoring will confirm if the trend holds in coming months.
